name: Thom Tillis
stance: Co-introduced a bill for a voluntary AI security and safety incident database, and cast the only Senate vote against stripping the proposed moratorium on state AI laws.

statements.text: With Sen. Mark Warner, introduced the Secure Artificial Intelligence Act, which would have CISA and NIST set up a public, voluntary database for tracking AI security and safety incidents.
This commonsense legislation creates a voluntary database for reporting AI security and safety incidents and promotes best practices to mitigate AI risks.
Cast the only vote against the Senate amendment that stripped the proposed moratorium on state AI law enforcement from the reconciliation bill, which passed 99-1.
